listing.name: Forza Motorsport (original Xbox USA revision 1) / DivxPlays Redline Recompiled
listing.summary: A PC port of Forza Motorsport (Xbox, 2005) by static recompilation: up to 144 fps, 4x resolution, ultrawide, DLSS and FSR. Bring your own disc. Early version: performance may be unstable; expect bugs and crashes. MADE WITH THE HELP OF AI.
